passage.label: Did not create jinn mankind except worship Me; do not want provision nor want feed Me; indeed Allah continual Provider firm possessor strength; indeed wronged portion punishment like portion predecessors let not impatiently urge Me; woe disbelieved Day promised

arabicExcerpts.text: وَمَا خَلَقۡتُ ٱلۡجِنَّ وَٱلۡإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُونِ
مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقٖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ
فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبٗا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the Lord-of-heaven-and-earth oath (23) before the Abraham-guests narrative opens (24); P2 ends with Noah's people as defiantly disobedient (46) before the cosmic-signs block begins (47); P3 runs from heaven-construction through the reminder-benefits-believers close (47-55); P4 covers the worship-purpose declaration through the closing woe (56-60).
